tests.title: User role sees only the operations menu
tests.goal:
Menu for the User role

Verify that an account with the User role sees only the operations and gantry log pages in the menu.
preconditions: An account with the User role

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the User account
Open each menu group

expected.text: The menu shows Dashboard, Inventory (Chemical Usage, Item Information), Registration (Item Register, Asset Tag Printing), Purchase Order (PO Creation, PO Management), Check In / Out (Printed, Tagged Not Checked In, Count Item, Check In, Check Out), Gantry (Gantry Log only) and My Account
Stock Take, Report, Master Data and System are not in the menu
The user button shows Role: User

notes: After the 19/11 deploy the User menu has Report (10 reports, all but Audit Trail; /loanoutreport opens) and Check In / Out shows Registered Not Printed / Printed Not Pre-Checked In instead of Printed / Count Item. Stock Take, Master Data, System still hidden. Waiting on Q-011.

tests.title: Create a purchase order
tests.goal:
PO Creation

Verify that a user can create a purchase order and find it in PO Management.
preconditions: At least one PO location and item type exist in the PO Creation lists
data: PO Number and PO Name: QA-PO-<unique>
PO Date: today, Delivery Date: today + 7 days

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Purchase Order > PO Creation
Fill PO Number, PO Name, Address, Supplier, Department, Team In Charge, Contact Person, Contact Number
Pick a PO Location and an Item Type, set PO Date and Delivery Date
Click Submit
Open Purchase Order > PO Management and search for the PO Number

expected.text: A success message is shown after Submit
PO Management lists the PO with its PO Number, PO Name and status
The Manager column shows the user who created it

notes: PO Creation after the deploy: 6 Submits with all required fields (ADMIN x4, USER1 x2), only QAPODEL812171 saved, and it appeared in PO Management only after a new login; no success or error message ever. No Audit Trail entry.

tests.title: Acknowledge an alert on the Dashboard
tests.goal:
Alert acknowledgement

Verify that acknowledging an alert removes it from the Dashboard and Alert History shows it as acknowledged.
preconditions: At least one alert requiring acknowledgement

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account
On the Dashboard note the count of alerts requiring acknowledgement and the first alert's text
Click Acknowledge on that alert

expected.text: The alert disappears from the list and the count drops by 1
Report > Alert History shows the alert as acknowledged with the user and time

notes: Retest after the deploy with QA alert 27 (High stock, QA high 373230): Acknowledge does nothing, count stays 23, acknowledgedOn null.

tests.title: Edit a registered item's details
tests.goal: Edit on Registered items not checked in yet saves the changed details, before and after the tag is printed, without changing the item number or chip code.
preconditions: A registered item without a printed tag (register one with QA data)
A registered item with a printed tag

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Registration > Item Register, click Edit on the unprinted item, change the description and serial number and save
Click Edit on the printed item, change its description and save
Open Inventory > Item Information for both items

expected.text: Both items show the new description (and serial) in the Item Register list and in Edit (Item Information lists items only once IN, BUG-017)
The item numbers are unchanged and the printed item keeps its chip code and Tag printed time
Audit Trail has an entry for each edit with the user and time

notes: 001000038 (Asset/Box, QA edit 446283): Edit before printing -> description QA edited 446283, serial QA-SN2-446283, team "QA team", "Item saved."; printed it (chip 010020000000000001000038) and edited again -> saved, same item number and chip code; Audit Trail "Item register edited" twice. Item Information does not list the item before check-in (BUG-017).

tests.title: Edit a purchase order
tests.goal: Edit PO in PO Management saves changed PO details and keeps the PO number.
preconditions: A QA purchase order (create one with HLW-007)

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account
Open Purchase Order > PO Management, search for the QA PO and click Edit
Change PO Name, Supplier and Delivery Date, fill Manager and Officer if empty, and click Submit
Search for the PO again and open Edit

expected.text: A success message is shown
PO Management lists the PO with the new PO Name, same PO Number and status
Edit shows the saved Supplier and Delivery Date
Audit Trail has an entry for the change

notes: Edit PO QAPO521908 (and PO001): changed PO Name / Supplier, Submit does nothing; Manager and Officer are required but both lists show "No Result"; only a hidden tooltip "SelectedItemManager is required.". No PO can be edited.

tests.title: Delete a purchase order
tests.goal: Delete in PO Management asks for confirmation and removes the PO.
preconditions: A QA purchase order made for this test (create one with HLW-007)

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with the administrator account
Open Purchase Order > PO Management, search for the QA PO and click Delete
Cancel the confirmation, then click Delete again and confirm
Search for the PO Number

expected.text: Delete asks for confirmation; Cancel keeps the PO
After confirming, the PO is no longer listed
Audit Trail has an entry for the deletion

notes: Delete on QAPODEL812171: confirmation "Are you sure you want to perform this operation?", Cancel keeps the PO, Ok removes it (gone after reload). No Audit Trail entry for the deletion (BUG-015). A fresh QA PO could not be created first (BUG-011), so the one saved attempt was used.

tests.title: A deleted user can no longer log in
tests.goal: Deleting a user in User Management removes their access, including a session that is already open.
preconditions: A QA user with the User role made for this test (HLW-030)

steps.text: Log in as the QA user in one browser and keep the session open
In another browser log in as administrator, open System > User Management and Delete the QA user (confirm)
In the QA user's browser open Check Out
Log out and try to log in again as the QA user

expected.text: The user is no longer listed in User Management
The open session is refused within a minute (login page or not authorized)
Logging in again is refused
Audit Trail records the deletion

notes: QADEL539047 (User) created, handheld signed in as it; ADMIN deleted the user (Cancel keeps it, Ok deletes). 1 min later the handheld "Update all data" still succeeded as the deleted user (BUG-014). New sign-in refused on handheld ("Username or password is incorrect") and web ("Invalid login attempt."). No Audit Trail entry for add/delete (BUG-015).

tests.title: Changing a user's role takes effect at the next login
tests.goal: Raising a User to Administrator (and back) in Edit User changes the menu and access as the dialog says ("Takes effect within a minute; the user may need to login again").
preconditions: A QA user with the User role (HLW-030)

steps.text: Log in as administrator, open System > User Management, Edit the QA user, set Role Administrator and Save
Log in as the QA user and open Report > Audit Trail by address (/audittrail)
As administrator set the QA user back to Role User and Save
Log in again as the QA user and open /audittrail

expected.text: User Management shows the new role after each save
As Administrator the QA user sees the full menu and can open Audit Trail
Back as User the menu has no Report, Stock Take, Master Data or System and /audittrail shows "You're Not Authorized!"

notes: QAUSER107393 set to Administrator: full menu, /audittrail opens. Set back to User (first save did not stick when the option was picked by text; picked from the list it saved; the Refresh button showed the old role until a page reload): menu without Stock Take / Master Data / System, /audittrail and /stocktakelist Not Authorized. No Audit Trail entry for the role changes (BUG-015).

tests.title: The Stock adjustment extra permission lets a User adjust stock take results
tests.goal: A User with the extra permission Stock adjustment can adjust not-located items of a completed stock take; a User without it cannot.
preconditions: A QA user with the User role (HLW-030)
A completed stock take with a not-located QA item (HLW-047)

steps.text: Log in as the QA user and try to open the completed stock take's Stock Take Detail (Stock Take List by address /stocktakelist)
As administrator, Edit the QA user, tick Extra permissions > Stock adjustment and Save
After a minute, log in again as the QA user and open the same Stock Take Detail
Adjust the not-located QA item to NOT FOUND with a reason

expected.text: Without the permission the user cannot reach or use the stock adjustment
With the permission the adjustment is offered and the item becomes NOT FOUND
User Management shows Stock adjustment under Extra permissions for the user
Audit Trail records the adjustment under the QA user

notes: Without the permission QAUSER107393 opens /stocktakedetail/ST00000015 but sees no adjustment section. Granted Extra permissions > Stock adjustment (saves when the label is clicked). With it the user adjusted 002000017 OUT -> IN ("1 tag(s) adjusted."), Audit Trail "Stock adjustment ... QAUSER107393 ... OUT -> IN". Found: the item stays on the gantry whitelist with purpose LOAN (BUG-016).

tests.title: A loan past its due date shows as Overdue in the Loan Out Report
tests.goal: A loan that is still out after its due date is reported as Overdue.
preconditions: An item with status IN
data: Purpose: Loan, Due Date: tomorrow, Remarks: QA overdue <unique>

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account and check the item out on Loan due tomorrow
Two days later open Report > Loan Out Report and set Loan status Overdue
Look at the Dashboard

expected.text: The loan is listed under Overdue with its due date and no Returned On
It is also listed under On loan (incl. overdue)
The Dashboard shows an "Overdue loan" alert: "Overdue loan: <description> (Item Number <number>) was due back on <date> (<n> days overdue)."

notes: Existing overdue loans used (no 2-day wait): Loan Out Report > Overdue lists 001000020, 001000019, 001000003, 002000003 with due dates and no Returned On; all also under On loan (incl. overdue). Dashboard shows "Overdue loan: ... was due back on ... (n days overdue)." alerts.

tests.title: Stock at or above maximum raises a High stock alert
tests.goal: An item type whose stock reaches its Max. stock raises a High stock alert on the Dashboard.
preconditions: A QA item type with Max. stock equal to its current stock + 1 (Master Data > Item Type), Min empty (Q-008)

steps.text: Log in as administrator and note the Dashboard alert count
Bring one more item of that type to IN (receive one, or check a loaned one back in)
Wait one minute and refresh the Dashboard
Open Report > Stock Level Report for the type

expected.text: A High stock alert names the item type, its stock and the maximum
Stock Level Report shows the type at or above Max
Report > Alert History lists the alert

notes: QA type "QA high 373230" (Consumable, Min empty, Max 1); item 002000026 registered, printed, pre checked in and checked in on the handheld -> within a minute Dashboard "High stock: Stock for QA high 373230 is 1 item(s), at or above maximum 1." (alert 27); Stock Level Report Level High.

tests.title: Register a chemical with Certificate of Analysis, SDS file and photo
tests.goal: The files attached at registration are saved with the item and can be opened later.
data: Category: Chemical, CAS number 64-17-5, lot QA-LOT-<unique>, production / delivery / expiry dates
CoA and SDS: small QA PDF files; Photo: a PNG under 2048 KB
SDS link, SDS issue date, License required with a license agency

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open Registration > Item Register, pick Chemical and fill the required fields and the SDS and license fields
Attach the CoA PDF, the SDS PDF and the photo and click Register
Open the item in Inventory > Item Information > Details

expected.text: The item is registered
Details shows the photo and lets you open the CoA and SDS PDFs with the content uploaded
SDS link, SDS issue date and license details are shown as entered
A photo over 2048 KB or a non-PDF CoA is refused with a message

notes: 003000033 (Chemical/Toluene, CAS 108-88-3) with CoA PDF, SDS PDF, PNG photo, SDS link, SDS issue date 03/11/2026, License required SCDF: registered; Edit shows View uploaded CoA / photo / SDS; the files download (application/pdf, image/png) with the uploaded content. A 2.2 MB photo is refused ("The file size exceeds the maximum allowed size of 2048 KB.") and a .txt CoA ("CoA file must be a PDF.").

tests.title: Stock Received & Utilised Report counts received and used items
tests.goal: Items received into stock and items checked out For use / No return are counted for their item type and period.
preconditions: An item type with items received and used in the chosen period (e.g. after HLW-016 and HLW-049)

steps.text: Log in as administrator and open Report > Stock Received & Utilised Report
Pick the period covering today and search
Compare the item type's figures with the Check In Out Report for the same period

expected.text: Received counts the items by delivery date (registration date when there is no delivery date) in the period, as the report text says
Utilised (checked out) counts every check-out in the period, Loans included (handheld, web and exit gantry)
In lab now matches the items of that description that are IN
Export downloads the columns shown

notes: Expectations corrected to the report text (Received by delivery/registration date, Utilised = all check-outs incl. loans). QA receive 789896: 1 / 0 / 1; QA print asset 42609: 1 / 2 (two loans) / 1; QA hlm 997823: 1 / 2 / 0.

tests.title: Stock Transaction Report lists an item's check-out and check-in
tests.goal: Each stock movement of an item appears in the Stock Transaction Report with type, user and time.
preconditions: An item with status IN

steps.text: Log in as administrator, check the item out on Loan and check it in again on the handheld
Open Report > Stock Transaction Report and search for the item number

expected.text: The report lists the check-out and the check-in in time order with the purpose, user and time
The item type and location are shown for each row

notes: QA print asset 42609 (001000031): loans and handheld check-ins listed in time order with event and user. Location empty on check-in/out rows; handheld pre check-in shown as "Registered to PO" (BUG-019).

tests.title: Aborting a stock take leaves item statuses unchanged and frees its items
tests.goal: An aborted stock take changes no item status and its items can be put in a new stock take for the same period.
preconditions: A QA stock take in Draft or In Progress with IN items (HLW-018)

steps.text: Log in as administrator, open Stock Take List, Show the QA stock take and click Abort (confirm)
Open Item Information for its items
Create a new stock take with the same items and an overlapping period

expected.text: The stock take shows status Aborted
Its items keep their status (no NOT FOUND)
The new stock take is accepted (no "Can't submit item that already exists on the same period")

notes: ST00000018 (002000025, 15-16/12/2026) aborted (by USER1, see HLW-065): status Aborted, 002000025 stays IN; ST00000019 with the same item and period accepted, then aborted as ADMIN.

tests.title: Two users checking out the same item at the same time: only one succeeds
tests.goal: Concurrent check-outs of one item do not create two loans or count the item twice.
preconditions: Two User accounts
An item with status IN

steps.text: Log in as USER1 and USER2 in two browsers and open Check Out in both
Both tick the same item; USER1 checks it out on Loan
Without refreshing, USER2 checks it out For use

expected.text: USER2 cannot check the item out: the Check Out list drops it (the page refreshes on its own) or the check-out is refused with a message
Check In Out Report has one check-out for the item and Loan Out Report one loan
Stock Level Report counts the item once

notes: Web (ADMIN) ticked 002000026 For use, not submitted; handheld checked it out No Return; the web Check Out list refreshed on its own, dropped the item and the selection (button disabled), so the stale check-out could not be sent. One check-out recorded. Check In Out Report check-in row shows NO RETURN (BUG-020). Handheld and web as the same account (no second web session available).

tests.title: Gantry menu links open the matching pages
tests.goal: Each Gantry menu entry opens the page it names.
preconditions: An administrator account

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web as administrator
Open Gantry and click Gantry Log, Authorized Log, Unauthorized Log and Gantry Whitelist in turn
Open System > Gantry Setup

expected.text: Each link opens the page with the same heading (Gantry Log, Authorized Log, Unauthorized Log, Gantry Whitelist)
Gantry Whitelist lists the whitelisted chip codes, not the gantry setup
System > Gantry Setup opens Gantry Setup

notes: Gantry > Gantry Whitelist opens /gantrysetup (Gantry Setup); /gantrywhitelist works by address.

tests.title: The User role cannot commence, complete or abort a stock take by address
tests.goal: Stock takes are administrator-only: a User who opens /stocktakedetail/<number> by address cannot change its state.
preconditions: A QA stock take in Draft for a future period (HLW-018)
A User account without extra permissions

steps.text: Log in to HTX LIMS web with a User account
Open /stocktakedetail/<QA stock take number> by address
Click Abort and confirm

expected.text: The page shows "You're Not Authorized!" or Commence / Complete / Abort are not offered
The stock take keeps its status (Stock Take List as administrator)

notes: USER1 (User, no extra permissions) opened /stocktakedetail/ST00000018: Commence and Abort enabled; Abort > confirm set it to Aborted.

tests.title: A stock adjustment that sets a loaned item IN takes it off the gantry whitelist
tests.goal: An item set back to IN through the stock-take adjustment is no longer whitelisted and its loan is closed, like a normal check-in.
preconditions: A completed stock take where a QA item checked out on Loan was located (proposed IN)

steps.text: Log in as administrator, open the stock take's Stock Take Detail
Tick the item under Stock-take adjustment, keep New status IN, enter the reason and click Adjust
Open Gantry > Gantry Whitelist and Report > Loan Out Report

expected.text: The item is IN
It is no longer on the gantry whitelist
The loan shows Returned with a Returned On date

notes: 002000017 adjusted OUT -> IN in ST00000015: Item status IN but exhibitStatus LOAN and GantryWhitelist/status true; Loan Out Report Returned with no Returned On.

Never-run web cases HLW-050..062 plus HLW-064..066 (found today), HLW-007 / HLW-020 retests and HLW-005 after the 19/11 deploy. Web as ADMIN / USER1 / QAUSER107393 / QADEL539047, handheld on emulator Medium_Phone.
